soundness_flags.label: ass:margin and def:triangular-causal-quantizer-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The margin condition uses dist(b_P(X),∂C_{P,K}), but ∂C_{P,K} is undefined for a finite codebook; define it as the union of its Voronoi boundaries before invoking the condition or its constants.

soundness_flags.label: def:triangular-causal-quantizer-class and profile-score definitions
soundness_flags.one_line: The class writes P=P_n although P_n is already the random empirical measure, and it does not impose W_P(1)>0 and sigma_{P,K}>0 despite using their reciprocals throughout rho_P, phi_rho, B_n, Gamma_n, and the band.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2405.03083v5, 2 April 2026; corroborating preprint version, not used to override the cited JRSSB version
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 9--10, Definition 3.1 and Theorem 3.1; p. 14, Assumptions A4--A6; p. 18, Remark 3.1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines a fixed-codebook margin condition, requires L2 propensity and sup-norm outcome-regression consistency for its corrected estimator, and explicitly states that it considers a fixed number of clusters rather than increasing k.
The article develops simultaneous confidence bands for many functional parameters using approximately Neyman-orthogonal score functions and a multiplier bootstrap for high-dimensional score vectors.

source_verification_receipts.version: Annals of Statistics 43, 2015, author-hosted published-version PDF
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies fixed-k quantization, gives a margin-based excess-distortion theory, and its displayed minimax result is for empirical codebooks over a fixed-level quantization class.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1412.3661, preprint corresponding to Annals of Probability 45 (2017)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The result concerns Gaussian and bootstrap approximation for high-dimensional sums over hyperrectangles and permits growing dimension; it does not construct the optimized causal scores used here.
The paper introduces generalized-moment-selection confidence sets and proves uniform asymptotic size control for moment-inequality and equality models.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1312.7614, preprint corresponding to Review of Economic Studies 86 (2019)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies maxima of many studentized moment inequalities, including multiplier-bootstrap critical values and uniform validity under growing numbers of supplied moments.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Machine Learning Research 21, 2020, published article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies convergence of optimal quantizers and their distortion performance for a sequence of source measures converging in Wasserstein distance, rather than causal-score inference.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair the primitive definitions: introduce a distinct triangular law notation P^(n), define the Voronoi-boundary set used by the margin condition, and impose explicit W_P(1)>0 and adjacent-score nondegeneracy conditions before forming standardized quantities.

State a transparent sufficient growth corollary under named uniform curvature, cell-radius, margin, nuisance-rate, and score-envelope exponents, then compare its K_n ceiling directly with the fixed-k result and the uniform witness.

Turn the transport handle into a theorem-level lower-bound target for one explicit nondegenerate subfamily, establishing either a matching resolution exponent or a concrete component of Gamma_n that is necessary for coverage.

recommended_next_step: Revise the undefined and circular profile/class definitions, retain the flagship growing-resolution band kernel, then advance the repaired core to Stage 0.
